high_level_description: The image is a simple line drawing of a flowing dress. The dress features a V-neckline with thin straps that crisscross at the back. The bodice appears to be fitted, leading into a full, pleated skirt that cascades down in a graceful, fluid manner. The lines are smooth and elegant, suggesting movement and a sense of lightness. There are no people or other objects present in the image; it is solely focused on the dress. The background is plain white, which emphasizes the simplicity and elegance of the design.
